parts.text: I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order, and I handle a few dozen charging pads at our sites. My work includes adding new drones to our fleet, retiring old ones, setting up charging pads at our sites, taking drones out of service for repairs and putting them back, and sending drones to charge. Regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after, and repairs and servicing are carried out by us technicians.
